raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/MainWindow: Final-assistant Omi mark ownership and canonical expandable tool-call presentation are row-level rendering contracts that belong with bubble equality and layout.
Apps search now owns an explicit unknown/loading/completed/failed presentation state so the UI never flashes a false empty result before filtering completes.

Home ask bar now auto-grows as a multi-line TextField so long messages wrap instead of scrolling off-screen (+14 lines over the prior SB-redesign home/chat layout); a component split is tracked follow-up.
Bridge memory search now awaits the active initial or pagination projection before refreshing, preventing an immediate post-navigation marker search from using stale lifecycle capability state.
Suggested-task loading feedback is now overlaid outside the list flow so an initial fetch cannot shift the task rows; a component split is tracked follow-up.
SB redesign: adds the hover-expand AppNavRail (icons→labels) and the merged/simplified navigation (Memory, Insights) driving selectedIndex; a component split is tracked follow-up.
